customer_name: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Administration (广东省政务服务和数据管理局)
business_problem: Guangdong needed to modernize investment-attraction outreach with an assistant that could answer policy and resource questions accurately, cut the cost of manual consultation, and show a reproducible public-sector path for large-model adoption.
solution_summary: This parallel 'Investment Guangdong AI Assistant' implementation emphasizes Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan and BaiGe stack as the technical base for Guangdong's province-level招商 service. The department used Wenxin large-model capabilities to rebuild the UNIT dialogue experience and to connect structured resource data such as parks, plants, buildings, projects, land parcels, and events with unstructured policy documents. BaiGe heterogeneous compute underpins the large-model workload, while the assistant exposes structured matching, policy interpretation, summarization, and search as one public-facing workflow. In the Heyuan pilot, full local resource and policy datasets were used for learning, training, and fine-tuning, allowing the assistant to answer natural-language investor questions and to surface the right resource or policy result more efficiently than traditional web or relationship-based招商 processes.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the core large-model capabilities for summarization, generation, and policy understanding.

solution_components.name: BaiGe Heterogeneous Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies the compute foundation for the assistant's large-model training and inference workloads.

solution_components.name: UNIT Intelligent Dialogue Platform
solution_components.role: Handles conversational interaction after being upgraded with large-model capabilities for招商 services.

solution_components.name: Investment Guangdong AI Assistant
solution_components.role: Presents matched resources and policy answers to enterprises and investors through a unified public interface.

data_flow: Guangdong's resource inventories and policy documents are ingested into the assistant's shared knowledge layer, where Qianfan models running on BaiGe process the content for matching, summarization, and Q&A. Investor questions flow through the upgraded UNIT dialogue interface and return grounded resource or policy answers through the assistant.
business_outcome: Guangdong strengthened the technical foundation beneath its AI招商 service, improved the speed and precision of resource and policy consultation, and reinforced the project as a reference implementation for public-sector large-model assistants.
metrics: The pilot reached more than 90% consultation accuracy.
The Heyuan scenario completed training and launch within 2 months.
architecture_clues: This version of the story explicitly adds BaiGe heterogeneous compute under the same招商 assistant pattern.
The assistant combines structured resource matching with unstructured policy-document search and generation.
Pilot-city fine-tuning is part of the operating approach for local rollout.

The assistant can answer questions over structured investment resources and over unstructured policy documents with natural-language generation (original: 现阶段具备招商资源结构化数据的精准匹配问答；具备招商政策文本文档非结构化数据的自然语言问答和生成).
